Sun Data Analytics helps clients collect, organize, analyze, and explain complex information through practical data workflows, automated reporting systems, mixed-methods analysis, and custom reports.

## Service Areas

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Data Collection

Collect, clean, and organize data from APIs, spreadsheets, platform exports, surveys, transcripts, scraped public sources, and other source materials.

[Learn about data collection](services/data-collection.html)
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Automated Reporting Systems

Build recurring report systems that turn raw data into readable reports, dashboards, tables, charts, and interpretation-ready summaries.

[Explore automated reporting](services/automated-reporting.html)
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Mixed-Methods Analysis

Combine quantitative summaries with qualitative evidence from transcripts, surveys, interviews, open-ended responses, and contextual notes.

[See mixed-methods analysis](services/mixed-methods-analysis.html)
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Custom Reports

Produce one-off or tailored reports for specific client questions, including data briefs, technical notes, executive summaries, and findings documents.

[Review custom report options](services/custom-reports.html)
:::
::::

## How The Work Usually Fits Together

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid">
  <article class="content-card">
    <h3>Start With Source Material</h3>
    <p>Exports, spreadsheets, APIs, surveys, transcripts, platform data, or public sources are organized into a cleaner workflow.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="content-card">
    <h3>Build A Repeatable Method</h3>
    <p>Analysis steps, classification rules, metric definitions, and reporting logic are documented so outputs can be reviewed or rerun.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="content-card">
    <h3>Deliver Clear Findings</h3>
    <p>Reports, dashboards, tables, charts, and summaries are written for decisions rather than just data storage.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```

Client data, private reports, and source files stay confidential. Public pages on this site describe the structure of the work and the kinds of questions the systems can answer.
